AC Bonus.description: While mounted, a halfling outrider receives a dodge bonus to Armor Class. This bonus is forfeited whenever the character would normally lose her Dexterity bonus to AC.

Alertness.description: The halfling outrider receives Alertness as a bonus feat.

Defensive Riding.description: Starting at 2nd level, the halfling outrider has mastered techniques of protective horsemanship. When she takes no other actions while mounted (attacking is not permitted during defensive riding), she receives a +2 bonus on Reflex saves and a +4 dodge bonus to AC. Additionally, her mount receives a +20 ft. increase to its speed, a +2 bonus on all Will saves, and a +4 dodge bonus to its AC.

Evasion.description: At 7th level, the halfling outrider gains evasion. When she succeeds on a Reflex saving throw against an effect that normally deals half damage on a successful save, she takes no damage instead. This ability only functions while wearing light armor or no armor, and is unavailable while the outrider is helpless (such as when unconscious or paralyzed). While mounted, the outrider extends this benefit to her mount, which may use either the outrider's Reflex save bonus or its own, whichever is better. If the character already possesses evasion, she instead gains improved evasion, though her mount still benefits from standard evasion as described. Improved evasion functions identically to evasion, except that on a failed Reflex save the character takes only half damage rather than full damage.

Full Mounted Attack.description: At 8th level, the halfling outrider may execute a full attack action even when her mount moves more than 5 feet, provided the mount moves no more than a single move action. This full attack cannot be combined with a charge.

Leap From the Saddle.description: Beginning at 5th level, the halfling outrider can leap from her mount and land in an adjacent square as a free action by succeeding on a DC 20 Ride check. If an opponent occupies a square she threatens after landing, she may immediately make a melee attack against that foe with a +2 bonus on the attack roll and a -2 penalty to AC, as though performing a charge. This ability can only be used when the mount is traveling at no more than double its speed.

Mount.description: Upon joining this prestige class, the halfling outrider receives a mount suited to what her community can provide. Typically, this is a riding dog or warpony, though the outrider is free to seek out, train, or buy a more unusual mount. Basic riding gear is supplied as well, though the character may opt to acquire masterwork or magical equipment. Levels in this class stack with paladin, druid, and ranger levels when calculating the abilities of a paladin's mount or an animal companion.

Quick Turn.description: At 10th level, the halfling outrider can attempt a DC 25 Ride check as a free action to make her mount execute a single change of direction while running or charging. The turn can be up to 90 degrees, and the mount is limited to one such turn per round. When charging, the mount must still travel at least 10 feet in a straight line after the turn. On a failed check, the mount continues 10 feet forward in a straight line and then loses its remaining actions for the turn.

Ride Bonus.description: The halfling outrider receives a competence bonus on all Ride checks equal to her class level.

Stand on Mount.description: At 4th level, a mounted halfling outrider gains the ability to stand atop her mount even while it moves or during combat, suffering no penalties to her actions, provided she succeeds on a DC 20 Ride check. When standing on her mount, the outrider suffers no penalty for using ranged weapons while the mount takes a double move or runs.

Unbroken Charge.description: From 3rd level onward, a mounted halfling outrider may charge through difficult terrain or through squares containing allied creatures by succeeding on a DC 15 Ride check.

Weapon and Armor Proficiency.description: This prestige class does not grant proficiency with any weapons or armor.
